text: {"status":"ANSWERED","claims":[{"text":"Emailing confidential customer data to an external partner requires approval from the data owner after the Vendor Security Assessment has been passed.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"Sharing Confidential information, including confidential customer information, with a third party requires approval from the data owner after the Vendor Security Assessment has been passed."},{"text":"The external partner must pass a Vendor Security Assessment before it receives any Confidential information.","evidence_id":"E4","quote":"A third party must pass a Vendor Security Assessment before it receives any Confidential or Restricted information."},{"text":"A Data Processing Agreement must be signed before sharing begins.","evidence_id":"E5","quote":"A Data Processing Agreement must be signed before sharing begins."},{"text":"The Data Processing Agreement must include confidentiality obligations and a requirement to notify Harbourline of a breach within 72 hours.","evidence_id":"E5","quote":"It must include confidentiality obligations and a requirement to notify Harbourline of a breach within 72 hours."},{"text":"Every approved sharing arrangement must be recorded in the Third-Party Data Register, including the data categories shared, the approvers and the review date.","evidence_id":"E3","quote":"Every approved sharing arrangement must be recorded in the Third-Party Data Register, including the data categories shared, the approvers and the review date."},{"text":"Confidential customer data is limited to people with a business need to know.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"Access is limited to people with a business need to know."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":[],"conflict_note":""}
